voice.summary: Writes like a demo reel narrator who knows the effect speaks for itself: clipped and confident. Each button name says what it does and nothing else.
dos: Name the effect in one or two words
Keep captions in lowercase technical labels
donts: Never explain a hover state in a paragraph

taglines: Eight ways to press a button

boilerplate: Pushlight is a collection of eight glowing button styles, from gradient sweeps to magnetic pulls, built for keyboard and pointer alike.

microcopy.empty: No buttons match. Clear the filter.
